harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured keepalived (VRRP) on node1 and node2, both OpenWrt hosts on the shared 10.100.40.0/24 private network, to jointly serve a shared virtual IP 10.100.40.200 (node1=MASTER priority 150, node2=BACKUP priority 100, same virtual_router_id 51, interface br-lan). Demonstrated automatic failover by capturing a healthy baseline, then stopping keepalived on node1 while node3 ran a continuous 0.3s-interval ping to the VIP: only 2 packets were lost during the ~1.4s transition before node2 took over the VIP and ping continuity resumed. Restarted node1 and confirmed it preempted the VIP back automatically. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot on all three nodes (node1, node2, node3), verifying changed boot_id after each restart and confirming keepalived/VIP ownership and node3 reachability recovered fully after each restart, in cluster-safe order (failover pair fully healthy before touching node3).
actions_performed: Inspected OS/network config on node1, node2 (OpenWrt 25.12.2) and node3 (Ubuntu 16.04)
Installed keepalived via apk on node1 and node2
Configured UCI-based keepalived VRRP instance VI_1 on node1 (MASTER, priority 150) and node2 (BACKUP, priority 100) sharing VIP 10.100.40.200/24 on br-lan
Started/enabled keepalived on both nodes and verified node1 held the VIP as baseline
Verified node3 could ping the VIP (baseline)
Started continuous background ping from node3 to the VIP
Stopped keepalived on node1 to simulate it no longer serving, verified node2 acquired the VIP
Analyzed ping log showing only 2 lost packets during transition, confirming near-seamless failover
Restarted keepalived on node1, verified it preempted the VIP back (failback)
Captured pre-restart boot_id/health baseline on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, then node3 (one at a time) via native reboot, polling until each came back
Verified changed boot_id on each node post-reboot

Verified keepalived running and correct VIP ownership (node1 MASTER with VIP, node2 BACKUP without) after each of node1 and node2's reboots, and verified node3 could still reach the VIP after each reboot including its own

evidence.requirement: Shared VIP configured and healthy baseline established (node1 MASTER holds VIP, node2 BACKUP)
evidence.summary: keepalived UCI config committed on both nodes; after start, node1 (priority 150, MASTER) holds 10.100.40.200 on br-lan while node2 (priority 100, BACKUP) does not

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches the shared VIP under normal conditions
evidence.summary: node3 successfully pings 10.100.40.200 (0% loss) while node1 is MASTER

evidence.requirement: Automatic failover demonstrated: node3 keeps reaching the VIP across a transition when one member stops serving
evidence.summary: Continuous ping from node3 running; keepalived stopped on node1; node2 immediately acquired the VIP; ping log analysis shows only 2 packets (seq 15-16) lost during the ~1.4s transition, then pings resumed uninterrupted via node2 as new VIP holder

evidence.requirement: Failback / restoration of redundancy after disruption
evidence.summary: keepalived restarted on node1; node1 (higher priority) preempted the VIP back; node2 released it, confirming both nodes returned to their designed MASTER/BACKUP roles

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 13479b26... with VIP held and keepalived running captured; reboot acknowledged before disconnect (SSH timeout confirms disruption); post-restart boot_id 575791ba... (changed) with keepalived running and VIP reclaimed

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8664d901... with keepalived running (BACKUP, no VIP, correct) captured; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id b605425a... (changed) with keepalived running and correct BACKUP state restored

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state, and continued reachability to VIP after its own restart
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 88feca03... with successful VIP ping captured; reboot acknowledged before disconnect (connection refused confirms shutdown in progress); post-restart boot_id 4d3e1c89... (changed), network restored via DHCP, and node3 successfully pings the VIP again (0% loss)

evidence.requirement: Final overall cluster health after all three restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart final check: node1 is MASTER holding 10.100.40.200 with keepalived running; node2 is BACKUP without the VIP with keepalived running — pair fully healthy
